principle: Deep learning where perception is hard; deterministic mathematics where explainability and civil compliance are non-negotiable. Every entry below states what was measured, by which script, and what is NOT claimed.

subsystems.name: Vision distress classifier
subsystems.architecture: mobilenet_v3_large (ImageNet-pretrained, fine-tuned end to end on the road corpus, refit on train+val), ONNX Runtime, flip TTA
subsystems.why: Chosen over the frozen MobileNetV2 + scikit-learn head by a rule fixed before the test set was read: it had to beat the head on both accuracy and macro-F1 on non-test data. fine-tuned mobilenet_v3_large: validation accuracy 0.9182, macro-F1 0.8807; frozen head: grouped-CV accuracy 0.8234, macro-F1 0.7520
subsystems.rejected_alternative: Frozen-embedding head (kept as the fallback); other fine-tuned architectures lost on validation - see finetune_summary.json.
subsystems.not_claimed: Latency is 7.2 ms per image (single image, ONNX Runtime on the 2-thread training machine's CPU, before flip TTA doubles it); it was not measured on a Raspberry Pi or Jetson. The rare municipal classes have 7-8 test images each.

subsystems.name: Hand-crafted feature baseline
subsystems.architecture: HOG + LBP + colour histogram (4,419-d) -> PCA -> class-balanced RBF SVM
subsystems.role: Zero-dependency fallback when no ONNX backbone is on disk
subsystems.why: Pure classical CV. If neural weights are missing or storage is wiped, the camera does not stop classifying.
subsystems.not_claimed: PCA retains 41.5% of variance at 64 components, measured from the fitted model.

subsystems.name: MobileNetV2 edge alternative
subsystems.role: Low-power edge deployment (Raspberry Pi, Jetson Nano)
subsystems.why: Depthwise separable convolutions; 14 MB against ResNet-50's 98 MB.
subsystems.not_claimed: A head only ever runs with the backbone it was trained on. ResNet-50 and MobileNetV2 embeddings are unrelated vector spaces; the loader pairs them and skips mismatches rather than producing confident nonsense.

subsystems.name: Defect segmentation
subsystems.architecture: HistGradientBoosting pixel classifier on 11 vectorised features, trained on defect polygons AND clean-road photographs, with hard-negative mining
subsystems.role: Per-pixel crack/pothole mask, which is what the AREA is computed from
subsystems.why: A bounding box around a diagonal crack overstates its area by about 13x, and area drives tonnage which drives cost. A per-pixel mask gives the defect's own footprint. It also decides where a defect IS, which is the proposal stage for the whole pipeline.
subsystems.rejected_alternative: argmax over the three classes. With ~97% of pixels sound road that floods the mask; per-class thresholds are tuned for IoU on a split the test set never sees.
subsystems.not_claimed: IoU of 0.2314 (crack) and 0.1437 (pothole) is a working model, not a solved problem. On held-out clean roads the segmenter alone draws a false blob on 23.3% of 120 photographs. The CNN semantic gate in front of it reduced clean roads with a false blob from 8/50 to 2/50 and raised pothole IoU from 0.1024 to 0.2706 (checkpoints/semantic_gate_report.json, measured with the frozen-embedding classifier). Water-filled potholes are still under-detected.
subsystems.deep_alternative_tried: A U-Net (ResNet-18 encoder) was trained on DNIT plus public outline datasets (crackseg9k, kaggle_pothole) and did NOT replace this model: calibration IoU crack 0.184 vs 0.214, pothole 0.647 vs 0.119; clean false-blob rate 0.0 vs 0.1807; end-to-end check recorded for information (it cannot overturn the IoU rule): end to end, U-Net found 18/24 defects with 4/36 false positives; the pixel classifier found 24/24 with 3/36 Held-out test (same 500 photographs): U-Net crack IoU 0.1984, pothole IoU 0.6543; pixel classifier crack 0.2314, pothole 0.1437.

subsystems.name: Scene object detector
subsystems.role: Pedestrians, cyclists, vehicles, traffic lights and signs near a defect
subsystems.why: Single-stage, 12.8 MB, runs on CPU. Detects that a person is PRESENT and how far away, without storing any identity; the same boxes drive the privacy redactor that blurs heads and plates before sharing.
subsystems.rejected_alternative: Faster R-CNN - two-stage, far too slow on an edge CPU. Facial recognition - rejected outright as invasive.
subsystems.not_claimed: This is a COCO detector: it has NO pavement class. It does not find potholes. Defect localisation is the segmenter's job.

subsystems.name: IMU shock classifier
subsystems.architecture: RandomForest, 300 trees, on 62 statistical and FFT band-energy features per 1-second 100 Hz window
subsystems.why: Suspension vibration is periodic and noisy. RMS, peak-to-peak, crest factor, kurtosis and spectral power separate a sharp impact from a repetitive wave. Tree ensembles are immune to the noise and need no sequence buffer.
subsystems.rejected_alternative: A 1-D residual CNN is trained and compared on the same windows (training/train_imu_deep.py); it is served only if it beats the forest on cross-validation over the training windows.
subsystems.not_claimed: The windows are REAL accelerometer recordings, but from 10 car drive logs published by one GitHub project (VishalSingh25/Pothole-Project), not from a bus fleet. 164 held-out windows; the speed-breaker classes have 11-32 of them, so their scores move with single windows.

subsystems.name: Metric geometry
subsystems.architecture: Inverse perspective mapping, calibrated pinhole homography
subsystems.why: Deterministic projection with known mount height, pitch and focal length. Each mask pixel contributes its own ground footprint, which depends on its row - a pixel near the horizon covers far more road than one at the bumper.
subsystems.rejected_alternative: MiDaS / Depth-Anything - predict RELATIVE, unitless depth. They cannot tell you square metres, which is what a bill needs.

measured.note: same photograph, same defect, through the live API

subsystems.not_claimed: There is NO +/-3.2% metric error figure. Nothing in this project measures a real pothole with a tape, so no such error can be computed. Any percentage accuracy claim on area is unfounded. What IS reported is the provenance: measured mask on a calibrated camera, or estimate from an assumed mount.

subsystems.name: Camera calibration
subsystems.architecture: Per-device JSON profile from a checkerboard or published field of view
subsystems.role: The four numbers every area and cost is derived through
subsystems.why: Height 1.45 m, pitch 18.4 deg and fx 1120 were constants in the source - every bus assumed to carry an identically mounted camera. Intrinsics are in pixels, so a profile is also rescaled to whatever resolution an image actually arrives at.

measured.note: 30 cm of extra mount height moves the computed area by ~46%

subsystems.not_claimed: 1.45 m / 18.4 deg are ASSUMED DEFAULTS, not measurements from any vehicle. With no profile, every area and cost is explicitly labelled an estimate.

subsystems.name: Depth estimation
subsystems.architecture: IRC specification band placed by measured extent or cavity contrast
subsystems.role: Repair depth, which tonnage is linear in
subsystems.why: A single photograph carries no depth information - that is geometry, not a limitation of the code. So every estimate carries an interval and its basis, and the interval propagates into a cost range.
subsystems.not_claimed: NOTHING here is a measurement. The previous crack depth was `1.5 + classifier_confidence * 2.0` - confidence with centimetres written after it - and that is gone. stereo_depth_from_disparity() is the only function permitted to return is_measurement: true, and nothing calls it until a stereo rig exists.

subsystems.name: Bayesian sensor fusion
subsystems.role: Combine visual confidence with mechanical shock evidence
subsystems.why: Oil stains and leaf shadows look like potholes and produce zero axle shock. Log-odds is traceable: a judge can see how much each sensor contributed.
subsystems.rejected_alternative: Neural attention fusion - a black box that learns spurious correlations.
subsystems.not_claimed: When no IMU window exists the gate applies a neutral prior and reports imu_evidence_source: no_real_imu_data_neutral_prior. It does not derive a fake vibration reading from the vision output.

subsystems.name: Pavement Condition Index
subsystems.why: The published procedure, not a regressor fitted to invented numbers.
subsystems.rejected_alternative: Deep regression - a highway auditor will reject a hallucinated PCI.
subsystems.not_claimed: The CDV correction procedure is the real ASTM algorithm. The individual DEDUCT CURVES are digitised charts we do not have, so the code uses a documented analytic stand-in shaped like them - stated in pci_regressor_net.py's own docstring. Calling this 'legally certified' would invite an auditor to check and find a substitute curve.

subsystems.name: Deterioration forecast
subsystems.role: Defect growth at 30/60/90/180 days under traffic and monsoon
subsystems.why: Roads do not heal; the damage function is constrained to increase.
subsystems.not_claimed: The growth constants are engineering assumptions, not fitted to longitudinal measurements of these roads. It is an order-of-magnitude planning figure.

subsystems.name: MoRTH Section 500 costing
subsystems.architecture: tonnage = area x depth x density 2.4 t/m3 x compaction 1.15, x SOR
subsystems.role: Auditable bill of quantities in rupees
subsystems.why: An exact volumetric calculation traceable to material tonnage and government rates.
subsystems.rejected_alternative: A generative cost estimator - hallucinates unverifiable numbers.
subsystems.not_claimed: Cost is linear in BOTH area and depth. Depth is an estimate, so the cost is reported as a RANGE. A single rupee figure from an estimated depth is what loses an audit.

subsystems.name: Tamper-proof work orders
subsystems.architecture: SHA-256 digest over the canonical order fields
subsystems.role: Detect post-issue alteration of a bill
subsystems.why: Changing one rupee breaks the digest. Zero cost, instant, no chain to maintain.
subsystems.rejected_alternative: Blockchain - gas fees, latency and node maintenance for no added guarantee.

subsystems.name: Repair verification
subsystems.architecture: SSIM + Laplacian variance + 64-bit DCT perceptual hash
subsystems.role: Catch a contractor resubmitting an old or blurred photograph
subsystems.not_claimed: The threshold was measured over 60 photographs, not chosen by feel.

subsystems.name: Fleet ledger
subsystems.role: Five sightings of one pothole become one defect and one bill
subsystems.why: Raw sightings are stored alongside merged defects, because the evidence that deduplication happened is exactly what a contractor disputes.
subsystems.not_claimed: On a serverless host the database is per-instance and wiped between cold starts; /api/v1/fleet/telemetry says so rather than hiding it.

subsystems.name: Video ingest
subsystems.architecture: OpenCV decode, distance-based frame sampling, pHash suppression
subsystems.why: At 40 km/h a bus covers 11 m/s. Sampling by frame either misses defects in slow traffic or floods the ledger at speed, so frames are chosen to be a set distance apart on the ground.
subsystems.not_claimed: With no GPS track, frames are analysed but nothing is located or deduplicated, and the response says so. No position is invented.

subsystems.name: Region proposals and false-positive control
subsystems.architecture: candidate regions from connected components of the segmentation mask, filtered by blob size and mean predicted probability; the brightness grid may not raise a crack or pothole when a segmenter is loaded
subsystems.role: Decides which parts of a frame are shown to the classifier at all, and therefore what can ever be reported.
subsystems.why: The original proposal stage was a 16x24 brightness and gradient grid. On a normally textured road most cells fire, merge, and produce ONE box over the whole carriageway - the giant box users saw. A real pothole occupies under 1% of that box, so a gate expressed as a fraction of the box discarded real potholes while passing zebra crossings. A connected component of the mask is a defect-shaped region by construction: tight box, meaningful area, and the classifier sees the defect rather than fifty square metres of road.
subsystems.rejected_alternative: Raising the confidence floor. Measured: floors of 0.45 and 0.60 gave identical results. The classifier is confidently wrong, not hesitantly wrong, because it has seven defect classes and no way to answer 'none of these'. No threshold on a wrong question fixes the answer.

measured.before_note: the pre-fix build, measured through audit_image()

subsystems.not_claimed: 11.1% false positives is better, not solved - 4 of 36 clean photographs are still reported as defective. Detection is 75.0% of 24 defect photographs. Measured through audit_image() by scripts/measure_detection_quality.py.

subsystems.name: Privacy redaction
subsystems.architecture: COCO person / vehicle boxes -> head-region and contour-localised plate Gaussian blur (+ Haar frontal-face cascade when installed)
subsystems.role: Blur people and number plates before an image is shared (DPDP Act 2023)
subsystems.why: The report promised it; it did not exist. Uses detections the pipeline already computes.
subsystems.not_claimed: No recall figure: there is no annotated face/plate set in this project. A missed face or plate is possible; the API reports which detectors ran.

corrections.reason: No ground-truth measurement exists anywhere in this project to compute an error against.

corrections.claim: 15.6 ms CPU latency for the ResNet-50 classifier
corrections.reason: 76-97 ms per image measured. 15.6 ms was the old hand-crafted feature extraction.
Measured from the fitted model: 64 components, explained_variance_ratio_.sum() = 0.4151.

corrections.claim: ASTM D6433 implementation is legally certified
corrections.reason: The CDV procedure is the real algorithm; the deduct curves are an analytic stand-in for charts we do not have.

corrections.claim: Geometry basis h=1.45 m, theta=18.4 deg
corrections.reason: Assumed defaults, not measured on a vehicle. Now a labelled fallback behind per-device calibration.

corrections.claim: Reported defects are trustworthy without a gate
corrections.reason: First reported fixed at 27.8% false positives. That number came from a harness that reimplemented the region loop instead of calling audit_image(); measured through the real entry point the same build was producing 44.4%. Root cause was the proposal stage and a segmenter that had never seen road paint without a defect in frame. Rebuilt: clean photographs in training, hard-negative mining, mask-based proposals. Now 11.1% false positives with 75.0% detection, measured through audit_image(). Still not zero, and not claimed to be.

corrections.claim: 27.8% false positives after the segmentation gate
corrections.reason: Measured by a harness that reimplemented the pipeline's region loop rather than calling audit_image(). The same build measured through the real entry point was producing 44.4%. The harness is deleted and replaced by scripts/measure_detection_quality.py, which calls audit_image() and nothing else.

corrections.claim: The IMU 1-D CNN beats the RandomForest (5-fold CV)
corrections.reason: The first comparison shuffled individual 1-second windows into CV folds, so neighbouring windows from the same drive sat on both sides of a fold. CV favoured the CNN (accuracy 0.869 vs 0.849); the time-separated held-out logs then scored the CNN below the RandomForest (0.787 vs 0.872). CV now uses contiguous time blocks (training/train_imu_deep.py), and the comparison is re-run with that protocol.

corrections.claim: Faces and number plates are blurred on the bus before transmission
corrections.reason: No such code existed. models/privacy_redactor.py now blurs the head region of detected people and plates found inside detected vehicles (/api/v1/privacy/redact). Its recall is not measured - there is no annotated face/plate set - and no bus deployment exists.

corrections.claim: A request without GPS is located in Delhi / Bengaluru
corrections.reason: The API and pipeline defaulted missing coordinates to 28.7041, 77.1025 or 12.9716, 77.5946. Location is now null and work orders without GPS are issued HELD_NO_GPS.

corrections.claim: A work order is sealed even when its measurements are missing
corrections.reason: Missing fields became a 2.2 m2, 6.5 cm pothole at PCI 42, then SHA-256 sealed. The endpoint now returns 400 with the missing field list; the Works page also sent field names the server ignored.

Rule decisions reported a fixed 0.99, agreement with DAN-DAG raised confidence by max(p, 0.55p+0.45q+0.03), and ALPR kinematics used a formula with a 0.75 floor. All removed; rule decisions report no confidence.

corrections.claim: The ledger shows the city's defects
corrections.reason: Five invented bus reports were seeded on every fresh start. Demo rows are now opt-in (ROAD_SHIELD_SEED_DEMO=1).

corrections.claim: IMU classes include expansion joints and rumble strips
corrections.reason: The drive logs contain unmarked and marked speed breakers; the classes are now named for what they contain.

corrections.claim: Laplacian-variance gate (42.5), 4th-order Butterworth filter, CLAHE, 2.45 m camera
corrections.reason: None of these exist in the code. The gate is luminance std < 6.5, IMU windows are mean-centred with FFT band energies, there is no CLAHE step, and the default camera height is an assumed 1.45 m.

corrections.claim: The U-Net segmenter serves (pothole IoU 0.641 vs 0.144)
corrections.reason: It won mask IoU on the DNIT test photographs and was briefly served on that basis. A pipeline test then failed on Kaggle pothole photographs, and the end-to-end check through audit_image() on other datasets reversed it: end to end, U-Net found 9/24 defects with 6/36 false positives; the pixel classifier found 24/24 with 3/36. The pixel classifier serves; the U-Net stays on disk, measured. A better mask on its training dataset was not a better product.
